text:
alex_chu: Quick Q — SOC2 fieldwork wants a 'playback' proving delegated KMS access for a simulated incident. Auditor phrased it as: signed log chain + delegation artifacts + approval trail. What artifacts are we comfortable providing?

maria_gonzalez: We can supply CloudTrail exports that include KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events, KMS audit logs from HSM for the same window, and a snapshot of key policies/role bindings. Also timestamped key rotation records.

jordan_lee: + include the ephemeral delegation token metadata (TTL, requester principal), the IAM rolebinding diff for the change, and the incident runbook reference (INCIDENT-1234). Minimal redaction for PII.

compliance_elena: Auditor asked for sampling guidance — they want two representative sessions and a broader 14-day log slice. We should prep: (1) two complete playback bundles with hashes and signatures, (2) an exported 14-day bundle with an index.

alex_chu: For integrity proof, will a sha256 + GPG detached signature per bundle be fine? Also want to include a short verification script the auditor can run.

maria_gonzalez: Yep — agreed. We'll produce a manifest.json with: bundle id, start/end, included log files, key policy revision, rotation id, and attestations. We'll sign the manifest.

jordan_lee: Small replay script I patched for the auditor to re-run locally (redacted creds). Example: 
```bash
# export cloudtrail for INCIDENT-1234
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventId,AttributeValue=INCIDENT-1234 --start-time 2026-03-01 --end-time 2026-03-07 | jq '.' > /tmp/incident-1234-trail.json
```
And for integrity: 
```bash
sha256sum /tmp/incident-1234-trail.json > /tmp/incident-1234-trail.sha256
gpg --detach-sign --armor /tmp/incident-1234-trail.sha256
```

devops-bot: export job started: aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/incident-1234/ /tmp/incident-1234/ --recursive — ETA ~2m :white_check_mark:

alex_chu: One more ask — auditor may request proof that delegation was authorized. We should include the approval ticket(s) (redacted comments ok) and the who/when/why mapping. Link to JIRA or ticket ID in manifest.

auditor_patel: This looks good. For the playback bundles we actually need: signed manifest, raw logs (cloudtrail + KMS HSM), the delegated token metadata, key policy at the time, and the human approval trail. Two representative playbacks + index for 14-day export is sufficient. Please ensure timestamps are in UTC and include verification steps.

compliance_elena: Got it — I'll own packaging the first playback and the index. Maria/Jordan can help generate signed manifests and the verification scripts. Will target first bundle by EOD PST.

maria_gonzalez: I'll generate the key-policy snapshots and rotation IDs, and add the policy diff. tagging bundle: bundle-20260315-01

jordan_lee: I'll watch the export and produce the verification scripts and sample verification output.

alex_chu: Thanks team — post the final bundle link here once ready. If anyone hits permission blockers for the HSM logs, ping me directly.
